# Verify final venmo friends match phone contacts
final_friends = []
page = 0
while True:
    page_result = apis.venmo.search_friends(access_token=venmo_token, page_index=page, page_limit=20)
    final_friends.extend(page_result)
    if len(page_result) < 20:
        break
    page += 1

final_emails = {f['email'] for f in final_friends}
print("Final venmo friends:", final_emails)
print("Phone contacts:", phone_emails)
print("Match:", final_emails == phone_emails)
